title: Running & hiding.
content: Last night I spent more than half of the night running from Tammy. I was dogging her trying to find safe areas. I auditioned for a movie part and won, she was not happy. (Turns out the movie was HER life story) I had to doge her in grocery stores, the theater, restaurants. Checking the streets looking for ways to get into the car, mazes through buildings. I woke up exhausted. Thanks Tammy! You’re a bully.
